🎥🎬: Last Samurai Standing (2025)

In 1878 Japan, the samurai era is coming to an end as the country rapidly modernizes. Hundreds of former samurai are drawn into a deadly survival contest called the Kodoku, where they must fight their way through Kyoto for the chance to claim a massive prize.

Among them is Shujiro Saga, a former samurai determined to survive and protect his family. As alliances form and old rivalries resurface, Shujiro realizes the contest is far more dangerous—and politically significant—than it first appeared.

Blending samurai action, survival drama, and historical fiction, Last Samurai Standing follows warriors fighting not only for their lives, but for a place in a changing Japan.

source_details.synopsis: Last Samurai Standing (Japanese: イクサガミ, Hepburn: Ikusagami) is a 2025 Japanese Netflix original live-action television series adapted from the novel of the same name written by Shogo Imamura. Starring Junichi Okada, Yumia Fujisaki and Kaya Kiyohara, and set in the late 19th century during the Meiji period, the series takes place at the Tenryūji monastery in Kyoto. The first two episodes of the series premiered at the 30th Busan International Film Festival in the On Screen section on September 18, 2025. Following its festival release, the six episodes series became available to stream worldwide on Netflix from November 13, 2025. A second season was confirmed by Netflix Japan.
